description: Control whether a conversion action counts toward the primary "Conversions" metric (and thus Smart Bidding). Set biddable=false to keep an action TRACKED but stop it optimizing bids — the fix for a PAGE_VIEW action inflating conversions. Operates on the customer-level conversion goal for the action category.

biddable.description: true = include in Conversions metric / bidding; false = tracked only, excluded from bidding.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

name: gads_set_conversion_goal_inclusion
